svg.title: Schedule
svg.desc: Original task-flow layout and wiring, styled for Moti-Pulse. Start; Choose “Goals”; Task List; Choose “Task List”; Toggle “Schedule On”; Task Create Sheet (with Scheduling with Date filled); Time point; Time period; Select date; Repeat On?; Select time; Scroll to choose; Choose reminder; Alarm?; Done; Daily; End day; Weekly; Monthly; Toggle Repeat on; Daily?; Weekly?; Toggle Repeat on; End day?; Select a date; End; Goals; Frequency Sheet (Toggle off); Frequency Sheet (Toggle on); Point time?; Done; Task Create Sheet (with Scheduling with Date filled with Time Filled); Reminder Screen (Toggle off); Toggle on; Reminder Screen (Toggle on); Choose time; Done; Task Create Sheet (with Scheduling with Date filled with Time Filled with Reimider On); Choose a Task.
